name: @dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-skin-manager
description: Skin manager for the dsh web GUI: scans installed ui-skin packages, lists them with previews in Settings, and switches the active skin by rewriting the home-layer patch mutual-exclusion zone (config HMR, no server restart). Dual-face: node half exposes a skinManager Remote service; browser half renders the Settings > Appearance & Skins page.
